subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should session-bound managed-image bytes returned by artifacts.download remain under operator.read, or require operator.admin despite other transcript-derived artifact reads using the read scope?
rationale: The choice changes which authenticated clients may retrieve host-local bytes and affects bounded Control UI tokens that intentionally lack operator.admin; code review cannot establish the intended permanent trust boundary.

options.title: Keep operator.read
options.body: Treat fully bound managed-image bytes as transcript-derived read artifacts, retain owner/admin-only direct HTTP, and require exact-head allowed/denied proof.

options.title: Require operator.admin
options.body: Raise managed-byte downloads to admin and align method scopes, protocol docs, UI recovery messaging, and authorization tests before merge.

options.title: Pause the RPC path
options.body: Do not merge the managed-byte resolver until a narrower credential or capability contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Keep operator.read
recommendation.body: Treat fully bound managed-image bytes as transcript-derived read artifacts, retain owner/admin-only direct HTTP, and require exact-head allowed/denied proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The discussion already routes the scope decision to this recent Gateway/auth contributor, whose work overlaps the affected HTTP and operator boundary.
